scope: All admitted opaque material slope observations, deduplicated by decoded image pixels. Retrospective exploration and prospective new-geometry cohorts remain separate. No fitted parameters here.

method.space: piecewise directional interpolation in linear-light sRGB; clipped to0..1 before sRGB encoding
method.weights: sin(b-theta)/sin(b-a), sin(theta-a)/sin(b-a); not normalized by their sum
method.anchor_input: Measured dark/left RGB plus measured top/right RGB, not nominal LDraw RGB

limits: 77 different image pixels include training, method selection, calibration and repeats of the same material/shape. They are not77 independent validations.
Eight prospective new-geometry images represent two slope shapes and three colors; all left-facing.
Right-sector multicolor holdouts and diagonal azimuths are sparse or absent.
Runtime azimuth blend and mirrored back-face colors are illustration conventions, not validated lighting.
Default research profile remains available and unchanged; the angular profile is opt-in.
